insights.summary: Customers want dashboards delivered to Looker, Google Sheets or BI tools on a schedule instead of manual CSV exports.
insights.quote: Honestly if it just showed up in a Google Sheet every Monday morning without me touching it, that'd be huge.

insights.summary: PreSense screen pop lost on transfer
insights.quote: But when a call comes in, agent sees the PreSense stuff, and then if they push it to a supervisor or another team, the second person gets nothing. Just a bare call.
